tasks.title: internal/simulator/ package — goroutine-per-device + payload generators + Prometheus counter
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/010-meshsat-simulator/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/simulator.feature}. SECOND: create internal/simulator/ with `Manager` type owning a map[imei]*Simulator. (REQ-904..907) implement 5 payload generators (text Markov-ish, position random-walk, telemetry random, sos literal, binary_random). (REQ-908) each simulator POSTs to the local /api/webhook/rockblock with the configured HMAC secret — use net/http client against http://127.0.0.1:6070. (REQ-901) duplicate start returns ErrAlreadyRunning. (REQ-911) increment hub_simulator_messages_total{device_imei, payload_pattern}. (REQ-912) Stop() shuts down all goroutines + writes simulator.stopped audit. Tests cover all 5 patterns + duplicate-start + clean shutdown.

tasks.title: REST API: /api/simulator/{start,stop,active} with owner role + mode-gated mount
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/010-meshsat-simulator/{requirements.md, contracts/openapi.yaml, acceptance/simulator.feature}. SECOND: implement internal/api/simulator.go with the 3 endpoints. (REQ-900/902/903) wire to internal/simulator.Manager. (REQ-909) auth.RequireRole("owner") middleware. (REQ-910 + REQ-913) at router mount time, check cfg.Mode == "standalone" OR HUB_SIMULATOR_ENABLED env var; mount endpoints only if either is true; in cluster-mode-with-explicit-opt-in, log WARN at startup. Tests cover all 3 verbs + role-deny + mode-gating.
